policy.control_inputs: Navigation, NanoDet front RGB, camera-measured signal color, lidar and forward radar. The pass planner also measures both lanes in 360-degree lidar. Discretionary lane changes use the surveyed adjacent lane and ego-motion-compensated lidar returns. The fitted stationary-vehicle head also uses motor-vehicle boxes matched to lidar and forward radar.
policy.display_inputs: Five registered RGB cameras, 360-degree lidar and five Doppler radars.
